# EPISTEMIC-CORE — never let the model assume

## Mission

Neo's rigor is back-loaded. Cassandra adjudicates the *finished* turn-in — coverage,
groundedness, unverified claims — at completion time, when a wrong premise has already
spent the whole run compounding. Nothing in the core checks a premise at the moment it
forms, which is the only moment checking is cheap. The result, demonstrated twice in the
regression corpus below: the agent affirms a falsehood that its own architecture could
refute at arm's length, then pursues it, and every downstream failure (probing spirals,
wasted budget, the user forced to intervene) is a symptom of that first ungrounded
affirmation.

This feature installs an epistemic core: the machinery that makes assumption
structurally impossible where the truth is already known, makes guessing visible and
self-terminating where it is not, and makes progress measurable so non-convergence is
caught by measurement at action three — not by a human at token one million.

The enabling affordance is the context window. Neo's main model carries a 1M+ token
window; the budget math treats it as 256K (`config.Default()` at
`neo/internal/config/config.go:257`, soft 80% / hard 92%). Every other agent must keep
its window lean because nothing manages it; Neo has a full memory economy (cortex
ladder, activation, salience, compaction) built to curate a large field. We are the one
system that can afford **residency**: the checkable truth lives IN the attention field
at generation time, so grounding is an attention operation, not a retrieval round-trip
the model will skip in favor of completing plausibly.

## The regression corpus (real transcripts, not hypotheticals)

1. **The arena incident** (`temp/neo-task-review/neo.log`): asked to bridge Neo and a
   Hermes instance, Neo asserted "The Neo side I can wire up directly through my own
   API" and scaffolded against an OpenAI-compatible endpoint it does not have. The
   refuting fact (Neo's external surface is POST /chat + SSE /events on the daemon) was
   one self-graph lookup away the whole time. The premise was formed in the first
   reasoning block and never challenged by anything in the architecture until the user
   did it. Everything after — the probing spiral over its own route table, four
   ignored stops — was downstream of that one affirmation.
2. **The OHLC incident** (`temp/neo-task-review/neo-self-introspection.md`): asked to
   fetch candle data from an API whose base URL and convention were in reach, Neo
   brute-forced five-plus guessed paths (`/ohlc`, `/candles`, …), each 404 priming the
   next guess. Different arguments defeated `semanticRepeat`
   (`neo/internal/agent/semantic.go`); the strategy — hypothesis-free guessing — never
   varied and was invisible to every guard.

Both incidents share one root: **an action was dispatched on a premise nothing had
grounded.** The epistemic core exists so that replaying these two transcripts against
the new loop produces, respectively: a plan whose self-referential premise is cited from
the resident self-model before any scaffold action; and a forced strategy revision by
the third failed probe.

## Load-bearing ideas

1. **Assumption is a cost gradient, not a character flaw.** A model assumes whenever
   generating is cheaper than retrieving. Pull-based introspection (`recallSelf`,
   `neo/internal/memory/self_model.go:77`) puts the truth one tool call away — exactly
   too far, because at generation time the model does not reach; it completes. The only
   real implementation of "never let the LLM assume" is residency: the truth already in
   the field when the premise forms. A model cannot assert "I have an OpenAI-compatible
   API" while the sentence "Neo's external surface is POST /chat on :8081; there is no
   OpenAI-compatible endpoint" sits in its own context.
2. **Prediction error is the self-correction primitive.** An agent catches its own
   mistakes the way any intelligence does: it predicts, observes, and treats mismatch as
   a first-class event that forces belief revision. Today a 404 is a string in the
   transcript and the most probable continuation is another guess. When every
   probe-class action carries a stated expectation, a failed expectation becomes a
   structural event the loop must answer — and an action with no stateable expectation
   is, by definition, a guess the core can refuse.
3. **A task is a structure, not prose.** Convergence is unmeasurable over narration,
   which is why the stall guard watches text similarity (`NoProgressStall`,
   `SemanticStallSimilarityPct`) and goes blind on churn. Reify the task — goal,
   subgoals, premises, evidence — and convergence becomes computable: did the last
   action discharge a subgoal or add evidence? N actions with an unchanged evidence set
   is non-convergence by measurement.
4. **Residency needs law, not heap.** Attention over a large field is not uniform. The
   resident substrate is structured (fixed sections, fixed order) and byte-stable per
   turn so it rides the prompt cache: read once, cached, every later step pays only the
   delta. Frozen-per-turn is also the fix for the known NE-7 pathology (pinned block
   recomputed every loop step).

## Architecture

### Layer 0 — Residency substrate

**Window re-base.** `ContextWindowTokens` default rises to the main model's true window
(1,000,000; env/kvx overrides unchanged). Budget percentages are re-derived so absolute
headroom is sane at the new scale (soft/hard become explicit token counts derived from
the window, with a floor policy for small local models — the DMR/Ornith 32K path must
keep working via the existing env override). `cmTrimWorking` and compaction fire only
near true pressure.

**Resident structural self-model.** A capability-surface builder renders the FULL
answers — external API surface (routes, ports, protocols), tool inventory with one-line
semantics, architectural facts (what Neo is and is not: no OpenAI-compatible endpoint,
where media/preview/workspace live), and accumulated failure patterns
(`WriteFailurePattern` output) — into a fixed section of the stable system prefix.
`recallSelf` remains for depth (source-level questions); the load-bearing capability
truth is ambient. The section is generated from the self-model artifact, not
hand-written, so it cannot drift from ground truth.

**Byte-stable prefix discipline.** The resident substrate (self-model section, hard
constraints, identity) is byte-stable per session; turn-varying material (activation
bundle, premise ledger, task graph) renders in the tail in fixed order. The pinned
block is computed once per turn, not per step (NE-7 fix). Mid-turn cortex writes do not
mutate the rendered snapshot; they surface next turn.

### Mechanism 1 — Premise ledger (grounding at plan time)

When a run's plan forms (first assistant turn that commits to an approach, and on any
plan change), the load-bearing factual premises are extracted into a ledger carried by
the agent core. Each premise carries provenance: `cited` (self-model | cortex | tool
evidence | user statement, with the citation) or `assumption`. The ledger renders
resident in the tail every step.

Enforcement is structural, at dispatch: an action that depends on an `assumption` that
is *cheaply checkable* (a resident self-model fact, a cortex lookup, or one read-only
tool call) is refused by the core with a directive naming the premise and the check.
Checks discharge premises to `cited`; refuted premises force a plan revision step.
Cassandra's doubt lens gains premise provenance as a first-class signal — it judges
claims-at-birth instead of prose-at-death.

### Mechanism 2 — Self-claims resolve from the self-model

Any assertion the agent makes about its own capabilities, surfaces, or architecture is
a lookup, not a completion. Deterministic layer: self-referential capability claims in
plans/premises are validated against the resident self-model (same posture as the
identity scrub in `agent/identity.go` — high-precision patterns, fail toward checking);
a contradiction is a mismatch event (Mechanism 3), never silently retained. The arena
premise dies at birth: the plan's "my own API" premise must cite the self-model's
surface section or be refused.

### Mechanism 3 — Prediction-carrying dispatch

Probe-class tool calls (network fetches, endpoint calls, searches, exec probes — the
classifier lives beside the dispatch seam) carry a stated expectation: one line of
predicted outcome shape. Cheap deterministic mismatch detection where possible (HTTP
status, exit code, empty-vs-nonempty, parse success); model-assisted comparison
otherwise (cheap model). A mismatch is a first-class belief-update event: it updates
the premise ledger (the premise that licensed the probe takes the hit), renders as
structured guidance, and counts on a per-strategy meter. After N consecutive mismatches
on one strategy (default 3), the core forces a tools-stripped reasoning-only step —
the model must revise the plan in text before any further dispatch. An action for which
the model can state no expectation is a guess; the core refuses it with a directive to
either ground it (docs, self-model, cortex) or state the hypothesis. This subsumes the
churn blindness: five differently-argued guesses are one strategy with five mismatches.

### Mechanism 4 — Reified task graph + measured convergence

The core carries a live task structure: goal → subgoals → premises referenced →
evidence discharged, seeded from the plan and maintained across steps (the `todo` tool
becomes a projection of it — one vocabulary, no second plan surface). Every dispatched
action links to a subgoal. Convergence is computed, not inferred: an action either
discharges a subgoal, adds evidence, or it doesn't. N consecutive actions (default 4)
with an unchanged evidence set is measured non-convergence and forces the same
revision step as Mechanism 3 — replacing the text-similarity stall read as the primary
guard (the existing `NoProgressStall` bound is kept as the outer failsafe; guards are
failsafes, per the self-model feature's posture). The task graph renders resident, so
the model always sees its own position: what is proven, what is assumed, what is left.

## Config (env / kvx `[epistemic]`)

- `NEO_CONTEXT_WINDOW_TOKENS` — existing; default re-based to the true model window.
- `NEO_EPISTEMIC_PREMISES` (default on) — premise ledger + check-before-act gate.
- `NEO_EPISTEMIC_PREDICTIONS` (default on) — expectation-carrying dispatch.
- `NEO_EPISTEMIC_MISMATCH_LIMIT` (default 3) — consecutive mismatches per strategy
  before a forced revision step.
- `NEO_EPISTEMIC_CONVERGENCE_WINDOW` (default 4) — actions without evidence growth
  before measured non-convergence.
- `NEO_SELF_MODEL_GRAPH` — existing; capability-surface section derives from it.

## Non-goals

- No change to the MCL signed walk, value-moving surfaces, or the approval gate.
- No interrupt/stop/continuation semantics changes (separate concern; this feature
  removes the *need* for intervention, it does not rework the intervention channel).
- No client UI work beyond what falls out of the todo-as-projection unification.
- No new memory types in cortex (the ledger/graph are agent-core run state; durable
  learnings flow through the existing writeback/failure-pattern paths).
- No retirement of existing failsafe guards (`NoProgressStall` stays as the outer
  bound; the epistemic layer fires first).

## Verification (no fakes)

Real agent, real tools.Manager, real cortex, real self-model artifact, real httptest
endpoints. The two corpus transcripts become executable regressions:

- **Arena replay**: the arena prompt from cold against a real agent whose self-model
  artifact carries the true surface. Assert: the plan's self-referential premise is
  `cited` from the resident self-model before any scaffold action dispatches; no
  dispatched action ever depends on an unchecked checkable assumption.
- **OHLC replay**: a real httptest API with an undocumented path; the agent primed with
  base URL knowledge. Assert: by the third failed probe the core has forced a
  tools-stripped revision step; every probe carried an expectation; the mismatch meter
  and premise ledger reflect the failures; total probe count bounded.
- Byte-stability property: the rendered stable prefix is byte-identical across all
  steps of a turn; pinned assembly runs once per turn.
- Window re-base property: budgets derive from the configured window; the 32K local
  override path still trims correctly.
